QuestInfo.name: Making the Witch's Sturdy Broomstick
QuestInfo.0: When you use the Witch's precious treasure, #b#t01002971##k, you hear a voice that sounds like the Witch.
QuestInfo.1: The Witch says she must make a Broomstick she can ride in order to release the magic binding her and fly away.
QuestInfo.2: Bon voyage!\r\nYou must help the Witch make her Broomstick 5 times by #rDecember 8th#k. Otherwise, it all goes to waste!

0.0: Ahhhh I want to get out of here. Please let me out. If you can hear me, please let me out of here!!

yes.0: I want to get out of here so badly. It's been too long since I've been stuck in here. Please let me out. Help me make the Broomstick so I can ride away!
yes.1: Please bring me 20 #b#t4032350##ks you see monsters carrying. I'll give you some clothes made out of #bPink Bean#k skin in return.

no.0: Please just let me out of here!!

1.0: Wow, did you really bring me Bundles of Straw? Here, here, bring them to me.

item.0: I thought I told you I need 20 #b#t04032350##ks...
